evidence.name: SeasonScoringReset

function_ir.summary: Resets season/session scoring state: clears the global flag at 0x7C5690, then loops a pointer from unk_5EC6E4 up to dword_7C54E4, calling TeamIDSetter with an increasing index and SessionStateTransition(-1, 0) per iteration. Returns the last SessionStateTransition result.

operations.description: Clear the global byte byte_7C5690 to 0 (initialization-state flag).
Seed the loop: index v0 = 0 and iteration pointer v1 = &unk_5EC6E4.
do-while loop that advances v1 by 4656 int-sized elements (the per-vehicle stride) and increments v0 until v1 reaches &dword_7C54E4.
Call TeamIDSetter (0x004C6960) with the current index v0 to set the team ID for that vehicle.
Call SessionStateTransition (0x004EF5A0) with (-1, 0) and store its return value as result.
Increment the vehicle index v0 at the end of each iteration.
Return result, the SessionStateTransition return value from the last executed iteration.
Called by DynMan_Post (0x0042C9F0) and sub_4A0490 (0x004A0490) to reset season scoring.

unresolved: dword_7C54E4 is treated as the loop terminator pointer; its role as CurrentVehicleIndex is DERIVED in existing analysis and not confirmed by this packet alone.
Semantics of the SessionStateTransition(-1, 0) arguments are unknown here.
Object type owning this reset routine is unknown.
